chapters.reason: The paper introduces a novel metric to quantify 'underthinking' by measuring token efficiency in incorrect answers, which aligns with developing new metrics to evaluate reasoning efficiency and overthinking phenomena.

The paper proposes a decoding strategy (TIP) that discourages premature thought switching to encourage deeper exploration, which relates to scaling compute dynamically during inference via search depth (sequential revision) and balancing search depth.

The paper's TIP decoding strategy implicitly manages computational resources by penalizing thought switching, which can be seen as a form of inference-time length budgeting to encourage deeper reasoning paths, though it does not explicitly set a token budget.
